Beginner.learningGoal: Write and pass closures, including trailing-closure syntax and returning closures.
gotchas: A closure captures variables by reference, so later changes are visible
Escaping closures must be marked @escaping when stored
Shorthand $0 in nested closures is ambiguous
goodSolutionShows: Trailing closure syntax and concise bodies
Closures as parameters rather than protocols for one method
shapeHints: a sort with a custom comparator
a function that applies a transformation N times

Intermediate.learningGoal: Understand capture semantics and capture lists, and avoid retain cycles with weak and unowned.
gotchas: Capture list [x] captures the value at creation time; no list captures the variable
weak self becomes optional and may be nil when the closure runs
unowned crashes if the instance has gone away
goodSolutionShows: Test using a deinit counter or weak reference to prove the cycle is broken
shapeHints: a button handler that must not retain its owner
an observable property with subscriber closures

Advanced.learningGoal: Reason about ARC, escaping closure lifetimes and cycles through collections of closures.
gotchas: A cycle through an array of closures stored on self
Capture of inout parameters is not allowed in escaping closures
goodSolutionShows: Break cycles with weak or unowned and prove deallocation
Minimal closure storage with clear ownership
shapeHints: an event bus with subscription tokens
a task scheduler that holds completion handlers
a cache with eviction callbacks and weak owners
